content: {"praised":["The show’s humor is enjoyable and keeps viewers laughing.","The characters’ relationships feel relatable and engaging.","The storyline includes heartfelt moments that evoke emotion.","The pacing keeps the plot moving steadily.","The overall tone balances drama and comedy well."],"criticized":["Characters are over the top and feel fake.","Cut-aways to Joan’s thoughts are annoying.","Music changes from original broadcast are disliked.","The show’s pacing feels uneven at times.","The tone sometimes feels too dramatic for the genre."]}
